## Ryanair Cabin Baggage & Underseat Dimensions (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/ryanair-cabin-baggage-dimensions.html
- Summary: Official Ryanair baggage dimensions: 40x20x25 cm (15.7x7.8x9.8 in) underseat bag and 55x40x20 cm (21.6x15.7x7.8 in) 10kg priority cabin trolley.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Free Underseat Personal Item**: Metric: `40 x 20 x 25 cm` | Imperial: `15.7 x 7.8 x 9.8 in` (Must fit strictly under the seat in front of you without forcing)
* **Priority 10kg Overhead Cabin Bag**: Metric: `55 x 40 x 20 cm (Max 10 kg)` | Imperial: `21.6 x 15.7 x 7.8 in (Max 22 lbs)` (Includes wheels and handles in Ryanair sizer)
* **Lithium Power Banks & Spare Batteries**: Metric: `Max 100 Wh (Max 160 Wh with approval)` | Imperial: `Max 27,000 mAh at 3.7V` (Never place lithium battery power banks in checked baggage)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:

## LG OLED C3 & C4 (42 to 83 inch) VESA Mount & Screw Dimensions (HARDWARE)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/lg-oled-c3-c4-vesa-mount-power.html
- Summary: Exact VESA patterns: 300x200 mm for 42", 48", 55", 65" and 400x400 mm for 77", 83". Exact screw size: M6 with 12-16 mm thread engagement.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **LG OLED C3/C4 42-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 300 x 200 mm (M6 screws, 12-14 mm depth)` | Imperial: `11.8 x 7.8 in (M6 screws, 0.47-0.55 in depth)` (Weight without stand: 9.8 kg (21.6 lbs))
* **LG OLED C3/C4 55 & 65-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 300 x 200 mm (M6 screws, 12-16 mm depth)` | Imperial: `11.8 x 7.8 in (M6 screws, 0.47-0.63 in depth)` (Weight: 55" = 14.1 kg (31.1 lbs), 65" = 16.6 kg (36.6 lbs))
* **LG OLED C3/C4 77 & 83-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 400 x 400 mm (77"), 400 x 400 mm (83") (M6 screws)` | Imperial: `15.7 x 15.7 in (M6 screws)` (Weight: 77" = 23.5 kg (51.8 lbs), 83" = 32.3 kg (71.2 lbs))

## Tesla Model Y Wiper Blades, Roof Rack & Cargo Dimensions (AUTO)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/tesla-model-y-wipers-roof-trunk-dimensions.html
- Summary: Exact fit specs: Wipers 650 mm (26") + 475 mm (19") pinch tab, Roof rack rating 68 kg (150 lbs), Trunk liner 108 x 105 cm (42.5 x 41.3").

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Front Windshield Wiper Blades (Driver + Passenger)**: Metric: `650 mm (Driver) + 475 mm (Passenger) [Pinch Tab 19mm]` | Imperial: `26 inches (Driver) + 19 inches (Passenger)` (Pinch tab push button connector (slim top lock))
* **Glass Roof Rack Max Dynamic Load**: Metric: `Max 68 kg (150 lbs) dynamic load rating` | Imperial: `150 lbs max dynamic load rating` (Attaches to hidden mounting arrow indicators under glass edge)
* **Rear Trunk & Sub-Trunk Liner Cargo Dimensions**: Metric: `Trunk Floor: 108 cm wide x 105 cm deep (854 L volume)` | Imperial: `Trunk Floor: 42.5 in wide x 41.3 in deep (30.2 cu ft)` (Deep sub-trunk well: 63 x 40 x 30 cm (24.8 x 15.7 x 11.8 in))

## EasyJet (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/easyjet-baggage-powerbank-guide.html
- Summary: Comprehensive guide to EasyJet's cabin baggage allowances, including underseat and overhead bags, and power bank regulations for a smooth journey.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Small Cabin Bag (Underseat)**: Metric: `45 x 36 x 20 cm` | Imperial: `17.7 x 14.2 x 7.9 in` (Included for all passengers. Must fit under the seat in front of you. No specific weight limit, but must be able to lift it yourself.)
* **Large Cabin Bag (Overhead)**: Metric: `56 x 45 x 25 cm (Max 15 kg)` | Imperial: `22.0 x 17.7 x 9.8 in (Max 33 lbs)` (Requires Up Front or Extra Legroom seat, easyJet Plus card, or FLEXI fare. Stored in overhead locker.)
* **Power Bank (Up to 100 Wh)**: Metric: `Max 100 Wh` | Imperial: `Max 100 Wh` (Must be carried in cabin baggage only. No airline approval required. Typically corresponds to 27,000 mAh at 3.7V.)
* **Power Bank (101-160 Wh)**: Metric: `101-160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` | Imperial: `101-160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` (Requires airline approval. Must be carried in cabin baggage only. Max 2 per passenger. Typically corresponds to 27,001 - 43,243 mAh at 3.7V.)
* **Power Bank (Over 160 Wh)**: Metric: `Over 160 Wh` | Imperial: `Over 160 Wh` (Not permitted on board as cabin or checked baggage under any circumstances.)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:
* 🇺🇸 United States: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇬🇧 United Kingdom: https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇨🇦 Canada: https://www.amazon.ca/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇦🇺 Australia: https://www.amazon.com.au/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21

## Delta Air Lines (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/delta-air-lines-compatibility-matrix.html
- Summary: Comprehensive guide to Delta Air Lines' baggage, pet, and battery policies, including exact dimensions and restrictions for a smooth travel experience.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Carry-on Baggage Dimensions**: Metric: `56 x 36 x 23 cm` | Imperial: `22 x 14 x 9 in` (Includes handles and wheels. Must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat. No weight limit unless specified for certain international routes.)
* **Personal Item Dimensions**: Metric: `45 x 35 x 20 cm` | Imperial: `18 x 14 x 8 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. Examples include a purse, briefcase, laptop bag, or small backpack. Dimensions are a common guideline as Delta does not publish exact figures.)
* **Pet in Cabin Carrier Dimensions (Soft-sided)**: Metric: `45.7 x 28 x 28 cm` | Imperial: `18 x 11 x 11 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. Pet must be able to stand up and turn around comfortably. Max dimensions may vary slightly by aircraft type and specific route. Prior approval required.)
* **Pet in Cabin Carrier Dimensions (Hard-sided)**: Metric: `45.7 x 30.5 x 28 cm` | Imperial: `18 x 12 x 11 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. Pet must be able to stand up and turn around comfortably. Max dimensions may vary slightly by aircraft type and specific route. Prior approval required.)
* **Spare Lithium-ion Batteries (≤ 100 Wh)**: Metric: `Max 100 Wh` | Imperial: `Max 100 Wh` (Carry-on baggage only. Up to 20 spare batteries per passenger. Must be protected from short circuit.)
* **Spare Lithium-ion Batteries (101-160 Wh)**: Metric: `101-160 Wh` | Imperial: `101-160 Wh` (Carry-on baggage only. Airline approval required. Max 2 spare batteries per passenger. Must be protected from short circuit.)
* **Lithium-ion Batteries in Device (> 160 Wh)**: Metric: `> 160 Wh` | Imperial: `> 160 Wh` (Forbidden in checked baggage. In carry-on, airline approval required and device must be protected from accidental activation.)
* **Portable Electronic Devices (PEDs) in Checked Baggage**: Metric: `N/A` | Imperial: `N/A` (Must be completely turned off and protected from accidental activation. Spare batteries are not allowed in checked baggage.)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:
* 🇺🇸 United States: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=delta+carry+on+bag+under+seat+pet+carrier&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇬🇧 United Kingdom: https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=delta+carry+on+bag+under+seat+pet+carrier&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇨🇦 Canada: https://www.amazon.ca/s?k=delta+carry+on+bag+under+seat+pet+carrier&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇦🇺 Australia: https://www.amazon.com.au/s?k=delta+carry+on+bag+under+seat+pet+carrier&tag=autocompat-21

## United Airlines (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/united-airlines-baggage-lithium-battery-rules.html
- Summary: Comprehensive guide to United Airlines' personal item, carry-on bag dimensions, and lithium battery regulations for a smooth travel experience.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Personal Item Dimensions**: Metric: `43 x 25 x 22 cm` | Imperial: `17 x 10 x 9 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. No specific weight limit.)
* **Standard Carry-on Bag Dimensions**: Metric: `56 x 35 x 22 cm` | Imperial: `22 x 14 x 9 in` (Must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat. No specific weight limit for most flights.)
* **Basic Economy Carry-on Allowance**: Metric: `N/A` | Imperial: `N/A` (Only one personal item is allowed. A standard carry-on bag is not permitted unless you are a MileagePlus Premier member, a primary cardmember of a qualifying United credit card, or a Star Alliance Gold member.)
* **Lithium Batteries (Installed in Devices, <100 Wh)**: Metric: `< 100 Wh` | Imperial: `< 100 Wh` (Allowed in carry-on or checked baggage.)
* **Lithium Batteries (Installed in Devices, 100-160 Wh)**: Metric: `100 - 160 Wh` | Imperial: `100 - 160 Wh` (Allowed in carry-on or checked baggage (checked requires airline approval).)
* **Lithium Batteries (Spare/Loose, <100 Wh)**: Metric: `< 100 Wh (Max 20 per passenger)` | Imperial: `< 100 Wh (Max 20 per passenger)` (Carry-on baggage only. Must be protected from short circuit.)
* **Lithium Batteries (Spare/Loose, 100-160 Wh)**: Metric: `100 - 160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` | Imperial: `100 - 160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` (Carry-on baggage only. Must be protected from short circuit. Airline approval required.)
* **Lithium Batteries (Over 160 Wh)**: Metric: `> 160 Wh` | Imperial: `> 160 Wh` (Not permitted in carry-on or checked baggage.)
* **E-cigarettes / Vaping Devices**: Metric: `N/A` | Imperial: `N/A` (Must be in carry-on baggage only. Batteries should be removed if possible.)
* **Smart Luggage (Non-Removable Battery)**: Metric: `> 0.3g Lithium Metal / > 2.7 Wh` | Imperial: `> 0.3g Lithium Metal / > 2.7 Wh` (Not permitted if battery is non-removable and exceeds specified limits. If removable, battery must be removed and carried in carry-on.)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:
* 🇺🇸 United States: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=united+airlines+personal+item+bag%2C+united+airlines+carry+on+bag%2C+tsa+approved+lithium+battery+case&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇬🇧 United Kingdom: https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=united+airlines+personal+item+bag%2C+united+airlines+carry+on+bag%2C+tsa+approved+lithium+battery+case&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇨🇦 Canada: https://www.amazon.ca/s?k=united+airlines+personal+item+bag%2C+united+airlines+carry+on+bag%2C+tsa+approved+lithium+battery+case&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇦🇺 Australia: https://www.amazon.com.au/s?k=united+airlines+personal+item+bag%2C+united+airlines+carry+on+bag%2C+tsa+approved+lithium+battery+case&tag=autocompat-21

## American Airlines (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/american-airlines-compatibility-matrix.html
- Summary: Detailed specifications for carry-on bags, personal items, cabin pet travel, and electronics on American Airlines flights. Ensure your items comply with regulations for a smooth journey.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Carry-on Bag**: Metric: `56 x 36 x 23 cm` | Imperial: `22 x 14 x 9 in` (Max dimensions including handles and wheels. No official weight limit, must fit in overhead bin and be liftable by passenger.)
* **Personal Item (Underseat)**: Metric: `45 x 28 x 20 cm` | Imperial: `18 x 11 x 8 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. Approximate dimensions provided.)
* **Cabin Pet Crate (Soft-sided)**: Metric: `46 x 28 x 28 cm (Max 9.07 kg)` | Imperial: `18 x 11 x 11 in (Max 20 lbs)` (Pet + carrier combined weight limit. Must fit under the seat. Pet must remain in carrier under seat. Only small dogs and cats allowed.)
* **Cabin Pet Crate (Hard-sided)**: Metric: `48 x 33 x 23 cm (Max 9.07 kg)` | Imperial: `19 x 13 x 9 in (Max 20 lbs)` (Pet + carrier combined weight limit. Must fit under the seat. Pet must remain in carrier under seat. Only small dogs and cats allowed.)
* **Lithium-ion Batteries (Devices & Spare, <100 Wh)**: Metric: `< 100 Wh` | Imperial: `< 100 Wh` (Allowed in carry-on or checked baggage (spare batteries only in carry-on).)
* **Lithium-ion Batteries (Spare, 100-160 Wh)**: Metric: `100-160 Wh` | Imperial: `100-160 Wh` (Allowed in carry-on with airline approval (max 2 spare batteries). Not allowed in checked baggage.)
* **Power Banks**: Metric: `N/A (Wh limits apply as per batteries)` | Imperial: `N/A (Wh limits apply as per batteries)` (Must be in carry-on baggage only. Not allowed in checked baggage. Wh limits apply as per lithium-ion batteries.)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:

- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/southwest-airlines-baggage-policy.html
- Summary: Comprehensive guide to Southwest Airlines carry-on, personal item, and pet carrier dimensions, including dual metric and imperial measurements.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Carry-on Bag (Overhead Bin)**: Metric: `60.96 x 40.64 x 25.4 cm (No stated weight limit)` | Imperial: `24 x 16 x 10 in (No stated weight limit)` (Dimensions include wheels and handles. Must fit in the overhead bin.)
* **Personal Item (Under Seat)**: Metric: `Approx. 46.99 x 34.29 x 21.59 cm (Must fit under seat)` | Imperial: `Approx. 18.5 x 13.5 x 8.5 in (Must fit under seat)` (Southwest does not publish exact dimensions, only that it must fit completely under the seat in front of you. Typical under-seat dimensions are provided as a guideline.)
* **In-cabin Pet Carrier**: Metric: `46.99 x 21.59 x 34.29 cm (L x H x W)` | Imperial: `18.5 x 8.5 x 13.5 in (L x H x W)` (Must be able to fit under the seat in front of you. Pet must remain in the carrier at all times. Carrier must be leak-proof and well-ventilated.)

- Summary: Comprehensive guide to British Airways' hand baggage and cabin bag allowances, including exact dimensions and weight limits for a smooth travel experience.

* **Hand Baggage (Carry-on)**: Metric: `56 x 45 x 25 cm (Max 23 kg)` | Imperial: `22.0 x 17.7 x 9.8 in (Max 50.7 lbs)` (One piece of hand baggage is allowed per passenger. This bag must fit in the overhead locker.)
* **Cabin Bag (Personal Item)**: Metric: `40 x 30 x 15 cm (Max 23 kg)` | Imperial: `15.7 x 11.8 x 5.9 in (Max 50.7 lbs)` (One small cabin bag (e.g., handbag, laptop bag) is allowed in addition to hand baggage. This bag must fit under the seat in front of you. Both bags can weigh up to 23kg each.)

- Summary: Comprehensive guide to Lufthansa's carry-on, personal item, and garment bag dimensions and weight limits, ensuring compliance for a smooth travel experience.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Carry-on Baggage (Cabin Baggage)**: Metric: `55 x 40 x 23 cm (Max 8 kg)` | Imperial: `21.7 x 15.7 x 9.1 in (Max 17.6 lbs)` (Dimensions include handles, pockets, and wheels. Weight limit applies per piece. Economy/Premium Economy: 1 piece. Business/First Class: 2 pieces.)
* **Personal Item (Underseat Bag)**: Metric: `40 x 30 x 10 cm` | Imperial: `15.7 x 11.8 x 3.9 in` (Must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions include handles, pockets, and wheels. No specific weight limit, must be reasonable.)
* **Foldable Garment Bag**: Metric: `57 x 54 x 15 cm (when folded)` | Imperial: `22.4 x 21.3 x 5.9 in (when folded)` (Can be carried instead of a piece of hand luggage, or in addition to two pieces of hand luggage in Business/First Class. Dimensions when folded. No specific weight limit, must be reasonable.)
